# 14-Day Symptom Tracker Plan

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/graph-up.svg

This 2-week log shows a repeating pattern: higher allergy days tend to line up with more headaches, less sleep, and slightly more caffeine. The goal is to make those relationships easy to spot in a clinic visit or at home.

## Symptom Pattern View

| Day | Headache | Allergy | Sleep (hrs) | Caffeine |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 2 | 5 | 7.5 | 2 |
| 2 | 3 | 6 | 7.0 | 3 |
| 3 | 1 | 4 | 8.0 | 1 |
| 4 | 4 | 7 | 6.5 | 3 |
| 5 | 2 | 5 | 7.2 | 2 |
| 6 | 3 | 6 | 6.8 | 2 |
| 7 | 1 | 4 | 8.1 | 1 |
| 8 | 2 | 5 | 7.4 | 2 |
| 9 | 4 | 7 | 6.3 | 3 |
| 10 | 3 | 6 | 6.9 | 2 |
| 11 | 2 | 5 | 7.6 | 2 |
| 12 | 1 | 4 | 8.0 | 1 |
| 13 | 3 | 6 | 7.1 | 3 |
| 14 | 2 | 5 | 7.3 | 2 |

### What stands out
- **Higher allergy scores** appear on Days 2, 4, 6, 9, 10, and 13, and those days also show **more headaches** and **lower sleep**.
- The clearest “flare” days are **Day 4 and Day 9**: headache 4/10, allergy 7/10, sleep 6.5 and 6.3 hours, caffeine 3 cups.
- Better nights, like **Days 3, 7, and 12**, align with **lower headache and allergy scores**.

## Two Charts That Will Reveal Patterns

### 1) Multi-line trend chart
Best for seeing how symptoms move together over time.

- X-axis: **Day 1–14**
- Y-axis: **Score / Hours**
- Lines:
  - Headache score
  - Allergy score
  - Sleep hours
  - Caffeine cups
- Why it helps:
  - Shows whether headache peaks follow allergy peaks
  - Makes low-sleep days easy to compare with symptom spikes
  - Helps a doctor see if caffeine rises on worse days

### 2) Scatter plot: Allergy vs Headache, colored by sleep
Best for spotting whether allergies and headaches are linked.

- X-axis: **Allergy score**
- Y-axis: **Headache score**
- Color or bubble size: **Sleep hours**
- Why it helps:
  - Makes the allergy-headache relationship visible at a glance
  - Shows whether worse sleep clusters around higher symptom days
  - Helps identify whether there is a consistent pattern or just occasional flares
